qsp.source_version: Dai et al., Water Research 235 (2023) 119814, doi:10.1016/j.watres.2023.119814; upstream repository has no tagged release and bundled-file snapshot correspondence remains unconfirmed
qsp.build_date: published upstream NR snapshot: 2021-11-11; bundled artifact build date unconfirmed
qsp.build_method: published upstream method: 38 HMMs constructed from 4,024 seed sequences collected through literature review, QSDB, UniProt and NCBI, followed by NR homolog search, keyword confirmation and profile-specific GA optimization; bundled artifact provenance to an exact upstream commit remains unconfirmed
qsp.license: Published as an open sequence database and publicly downloadable from the upstream repository; no explicit repository license file was identified, so applicable upstream terms still require confirmation; redistribution with QSCN confirmed by the project owner on 2026-08-10

kegg-m02024.source_version: KEGG map02024 reference pathway; extraction date/KEGG release and profile source version unconfirmed
kegg-m02024.build_method: pathway roles were manually extracted from the KEGG map02024 reference pathway; organism names in pathway labels identify model systems shown on the reference map and are not taxonomic restrictions; component display names were imported from the project-owner-supplied kegg_symbols_and_names.txt PROTEIN NAME IN KEGG column, with blank values represented as NA; construction of the combined 281-profile KEGG-derived HMM library remains unconfirmed
kegg-m02024.license: KEGG terms apply; redistribution with QSCN confirmed by the project owner on 2026-08-10
